title: Gensee Crate policy document
description: Schema for the gensee policy document (default-policy.json or $GENSEE_HOME/policy.json). Point your editor's JSON schema mapping at this file for validation + autocomplete. Authoritative validation is `gensee policy validate <file>`.

schema_version.description: Version 2 adds Endpoint Security recording and retention controls. Version 1 remains readable for migration; new documents should use 2.

version.description: Human-readable revision tag, e.g. a date.

review_overrides.description: Developer-reviewed severity and enforcement adjustments keyed by stable rule ID.

operations.description: Operation-class membership: which file operations count as read / destructive / metadata / mutating.

content_rules.description: Substring/shape matchers over the content of an executed script.

url_rules.description: Host-matched URL rules (e.g. cloud metadata endpoints).

command_rules.description: Token-boundary command matchers (fork bomb, firewall flush, sudo, ...).

resource_governance.description: Resource caps (env override: GENSEE_MAX_*). Omitted fields use built-in defaults.

egress.description: Network egress controls (env override: GENSEE_EGRESS_ALLOW_HOSTS / GENSEE_EGRESS_PROXY_URL / GENSEE_REQUIRE_EGRESS_PROXY).

allow_hosts.description: Allowed egress hosts; empty = no host restriction.

linux.description: Linux host-enforcement defaults for managed agent launches.

seccomp.description: Seccomp syscall-deny defaults applied by `gensee run --sandbox linux`.

fanotify.description: Extra Linux fanotify sensitive-path marks added on top of built-in credential-path defaults.

paths.description: Exact paths or /path/** prefixes to enforce with fanotify permission events.

network.description: Cgroup/nftables egress defaults applied by `gensee run --sandbox linux`.

allow.description: Allowed IP/CIDR destinations for allowlist mode.

deny.description: Denied IP/CIDR destinations applied before allow rules.

noninteractive.description: When true, escalate medium+ `ask` findings to `deny` (fail closed with no operator).

endpoint_security.description: First-party macOS Endpoint Security sensor and authorization posture.

protected_paths.description: Additional absolute path prefixes protected by authorization events.

blocked_executables.description: Absolute executable paths denied inside managed agent trees in protect/strict mode.

fail_closed_managed_only.description: Reserved safety invariant: authorization denies are always limited to explicitly managed agent process trees.

minimum_recorded_severity.description: Lowest alert severity persisted locally. Enforcement still evaluates every finding.

raw_event_scope.description: Persist no raw events, only events correlated to an active agent tool call, or every observed Endpoint Security event. All is the default; age and count retention bound storage.

low_severity_retention_hours.description: Permanently delete info, low, and medium alerts after this many hours; null keeps them indefinitely.

cowork_endpoint_visibility.description: Opt-in macOS management and origin labeling for the Claude Desktop Cowork process tree.

enabled.description: Register running Claude Desktop processes as managed Endpoint Security roots.

session_mode.description: Externally established Cowork mode. Unknown prevents Crate from guessing from the host helper identity.

system_events.description: System-event backend started by `gensee watch` unless overridden with --system-events.

allow_path_prefixes.description: Trusted path prefixes exempt from secret/persistence findings (env override: GENSEE_POLICY_ALLOW_PATH_PREFIXES).
